source_title: Oppo Reno17 F 5G gets NBTC certified
source_excerpt:
Oppo has confirmed it will unveil the Reno17 series in China next month, but it hasn't officially said when it will launch internationally. While we await more information on the Reno17 series' global debut, Thailand's NBTC has certified the Reno17 F 5G, bringing it a step closer to launch.
The NBTC listing for the Reno17 F 5G includes its model code, CPH3013, but it doesn't reveal anything else. However, the Reno17 F 5G has already received certifications from other authorities, including India's BIS and Indonesia's TKDN, suggesting its international debut isn't far off.
The Reno17 F 5G has been certified by NBD as well, which revealed the smartphone will come with a 6.57" OLED display, 12GB RAM, and 512GB storage.
Before the Reno17 F 5G, the Reno17 5G with model code CPH2975 was also certified by NBTC. Expect to hear more about the Reno17 series devices from Oppo in the coming weeks.
